verified_scope: A lower-range TBP expansion produces an SCA17 parkinsonism phenotype, including visual hallucination history and cognitive fluctuations. No dried figs.
An antibody-positive clinical case has parkinsonism, visual hallucination and ataxia with a subsequent Morvan syndrome. A separate case from abstract 9.
A TARDBP mutation is reported with atypical parkinsonism, neurocognitive impairment and visual hallucinations. No food-based measure.
The case describes visual hallucinations with insight after occipital ischemia, with no dried fig or Parkinson intervention.
The pembrolizumab encephalitis member describes visual hallucinations with cognitive and emotional changes during immunotherapy. Different patient and exposure from the stroke report.
The report considers infection-related encephalopathy versus acyclovir toxicity. Visual hallucinations occur in an acute illness differential and have no dietary observation.
